sloka: काक पक्ष धरम् शूरम् ज्येष्ठम् मे दातुम् अर्हसि ।शक्तो हि येष मया गुप्तो दिव्येन स्वेन तेजसा ॥१-१९-९॥
transliteration: kāka pakṣa dharam śūram jyeṣṭham me dātum arhasi ।śakto hi yeṣa mayā gupto divyena svena tejasā ॥1-19-9॥

translations.english: Protected by me and by his own divine power, Rama is capable of destroying even those demons causing impediments to the sacrifice.
